articles.headline: World Cup: USA odds shorten versus Belgium after Balogun red card reprieve
articles.description: Team USA's leading scorer Folarin Balogun's return to the lineup has shortened already-favorited USA's odds to advance.

articles.headline: World Cup Daily live: Harry Kane loses voice in hilarious interview, USMNT prepares for Belgium
articles.description: Enjoy all the features, news, video analysis and color from around the World Cup as Portugal face Spain and the USMNT take on Belgium.

articles.headline: What's next for Brazil after another painful World Cup exit?
articles.description: Brazil had to wait 28 years to win their first World Cup. Sunday's elimination means they'll be waiting 28 years, at least, for their next one.

articles.headline: Belgium want FIFA to explain Balogun reversal, challenge USMNT striker's eligibility
articles.description: The Belgian football federation wants explanation from FIFA about a decision to let United States forward Folarin Balogun play at the World Cup despite getting a red card in his previous game.

articles.headline: World Cup: Grades for every eliminated team as they exit the tournament
articles.description: When the World Cup ends, 47 teams will have been eliminated, and we're grading every one on how their run compared with expectations.

articles.headline: Have Brazil lost aura that made them defining World Cup team?
articles.description: Brazil used to be synonymous with the World Cup, adored for the way they played as much as for winning more than any other team. Have they lost that magic?
